args.stdin: WITH family AS (SELECT product_family_id FROM product_families WHERE brand = 'Honeywell' AND product_family_name = 'Honeywell Pro HW 2GM-UMP Respiratory Protection'), variants AS (SELECT pv.* FROM product_variants pv JOIN family f ON pv.product_family_id = f.product_family_id WHERE pv.brand = 'Honeywell'), with_props AS (SELECT pv.* FROM variants pv WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties pvp WHERE pvp.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND pvp.property_key = 'mask_type' AND pvp.property_value_text = 'dust mask') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties pvp WHERE pvp.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND pvp.property_key = 'protection_class' AND pvp.property_value_text = 'basic')) SELECT product_sku, record_path, product_name, price_cents, price_currency FROM with_props;
